title: A calculation item filtered in CALCULATE is applied to the measure: SELECTEDMEASURE () becomes the measure

source.quote: A calculation item is applied by replacing measure references invoked when there is a calculation item active in the filter context.
source.supports: [Total] is replaced by the item's expression with SELECTEDMEASURE () standing for [Total]

source.quote: A reference to the measure that is currently in context when the calculation item is evaluated.

derivation: Plus 2 is SELECTEDMEASURE () + 2. [Total] = 10 + 20 + 30 = 60, so the result is 62. Integer + integer is an integer.
